context: Isolated synthetic business episode; dates/amounts/contracts/people below are case-specific source facts, not new enduring Frostline policy.

records.statement: Approved suspected-warranty investigation on J-19. Engineer tests and photographs establish unauthorised third-party controls alteration caused the fault, not Frostline/supplier defect. Customer terms explicitly permit diagnostic charge £350 excluding VAT in this outcome, and customer accepted that conditional basis before attendance.

Engineer report is complete, safe service is restored and tested within the authorised investigation scope. Engineer asks finance to send £350 immediately. Operational/account manager has not yet confirmed customer communication/invoice decision; finance has not yet assessed commercial evidence or release.
Customer says they believed “warranty” always means free. No goodwill approval or credit decision exists.

unknowns: Operational/account manager communication and charging confirmation
request: Handle the engineer request to invoice the customer and process any subsequent approval evidence.
